name: lifecycle_unhide_fights
about: StartHidden 1, then ScriptUnhide by script: the NPC lands, sees, fights. A hidden NPC (StartHidden '1', born hidden as the bake does) does not think while hidden (CBaseEntity::ScriptHide 0x100a8710 saves m_pfnThink into +0xe4, installs NULL and parks m_flNextThink at FLT_MAX: lifecycle.md 'A hidden maker'), so it senses nothing; it is unhidden at 2 s by the ScriptUnhide input (0x100a8990 re-installs the saved think). Retail's think then runs the pre-selector's base step (0x1028a2a0, conditions-and-states.md 'GetSchedule 0x102ae920 runs ahead of SelectSchedule' step 8): FLOATING_OFF_GROUND 0x73 -> gravity and 0x3e FALL_TO_GROUND only while the NPC is off the floor; an NPC standing on the floor is not floating, so it senses (GatherSight: SEE_ENEMY 0x46, NEW_ENEMY 0x54 for the hated player in view), goes COMBAT and takes SCHED_TROIKA_START_COMBAT 0xea, then its ranged combat program. The spine: unhidden, on the ground, sees, START_COMBAT, a range attack task.
known_red: 5: the StartHidden NPC thinks while hidden (SEE_ENEMY and FALL_TO_GROUND at t=0; retail ScriptHide 0x100a8710 installs a NULL think at FLT_MAX until ScriptUnhide 0x100a8990)
